title: Pooling - 2ml Tuberack to 15ml Tuberack
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Create worklist file
steps.instruction:
Create a plain‑text worklist file that follows the required format. Example content:
```
Number 8 pos TB_RCK_1,pos MTP_1,transfer_vol TUBE BAR 1,TUBE BAR 1
1,1,200
2,35,200
3,2,150
4,90,100
5,84
6,62
7,42
8,18
...
```

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to **More > Custom Labware > Add Labware** and select your labware JSON files (e.g., the 2 mL and 15 mL tuberack definitions) if they are not already present.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (with a .py extension) to the OT App using the **Protocol** tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 deck according to the provided deck map for the pooling protocol (place the 2 mL tuberack, 15 mL tuberack, tip rack, and any other required labware in the specified slots).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette. Refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Execute pooling protocol
steps.instruction: Start the uploaded protocol; it will read the worklist and perform the custom pooling from the 2 mL tuberack to the 15 mL tuberack as specified.
